Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its established blue ecommerce advertising design and front/back overlapping composition. Images2,3,4,5 are ACTUAL PRODUCT evidence: actual SILVER BACK, actual face/controls closeup, actual front, actual side. Do not redesign the ad. Correct only the following clearly identified PRODUCT inaccuracies; no change to text-zone layout or background.
1. BACK VIEW CORRECTION: the smaller rear-facing product at LEFT in image1 currently has a wrongly invented raised long vertical ridge/spout at its head-to-neck junction, approximately x195..285,y370..560 in1254square. This part belongs to another product and MUST BE REMOVED COMPLETELY. The real rear shell in image2 is a smooth uninterrupted shallow convex silver teardrop, its broad circular head gradually narrowing continuously into the long smooth neck/handle. No protruding rib, blade, rear nozzle, vent, seam, raised rod, spine, added component or extra control. Reconstruct this local rear head/neck surface to match image2 and actual side image5: continuous polished mirror silver with soft broad studio reflection, no physical ridge even if lit. The gray circular spot visible in actual image2 is NOT a designed feature and must NOT be copied. Back should be clean with no round mark/patch/button/sticker. Keep the left product in the same location, scale and overall silhouette and do not turn it into another front view.
2. WHITE RING CLEANUP: in the large foreground black face and the right closeup window, each existing white nozzle should be one discrete small off-white circular/elliptical ring around one dark center opening as actual image3, not a blurred triangle, fused pair, bright slash or ghost ring. Retain existing ring center layout, spacing and amount as closely as possible; don't replace panel by a new grid. In particular remove obvious small ring smears at upper-left and middle-left of the big face. Preserve black texture, concentric outer dark-hole border, original small red low flange-and-boss control and silver lower selector. No extra large black pedestal.
PRESERVE: blue vertical ribbed glass/window-light background, the two blue empty feature pills at right, top-right empty title zone, red-control inset position and border, dark full-width lower blank banner, foreground product pose and complete silver threaded bottom, back product pose, major front head/cylinder geometry and flowing neck, existing bright mirror silver visual finish, dry resting state. Do not move/resize title zones, change lighting scheme or add any writing. No hand/person/water/hose/holder, no gold or black SKU. Output same square entire composition. This is a product repair of image1, not a new variation; all five real-photo constraints outrank any accidental structure in edit target.
